mapper.select: SELECT CR.ID AS id , CR.SENDER_EMAIL AS senderEmail , CR.RECEIVER_EMAIL AS receiverEmail , MI1.MEM_NICKNAME AS senderNickname , MI2.MEM_NICKNAME AS receiverNickname , MI1.MEM_PROFILE_IMG AS senderProfileImg , MI2.MEM_PROFILE_IMG AS receiverProfileImg , ( SELECT CONTENT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_ID = CR.ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS lastMessage , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_ID = CR.ID AND SENDER_EMAIL != #{memEmail} AND IS_READ = 0 ) AS unreadCount FROM CHAT_ROOM CR LEFT JOIN MEM_INFO MI1 ON CR.SENDER_EMAIL = MI1.MEM_EMAIL LEFT JOIN MEM_INFO MI2 ON CR.RECEIVER_EMAIL = MI2.MEM_EMAIL WHERE CR.SENDER_EMAIL = #{memEmail} OR CR.RECEIVER_EMAIL = #{memEmail} ORDER BY CR.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT CM.ID AS id , CM.ROOM_ID AS roomId , CM.SENDER_EMAIL AS senderEmail , MI.MEM_NICKNAME AS senderNickname , CM.CONTENT AS content , CM.CREATED_AT AS createdAt , CM.IS_READ AS isRead , MI.MEM_PROFILE_IMG AS senderProfileImg FROM CHAT_MESSAGE CM LEFT JOIN MEM_INFO MI ON CM.SENDER_EMAIL = MI.MEM_EMAIL WHERE CM.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY CM.CREATED_AT ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE CHAT_MESSAGE SET IS_READ = 1 WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND SENDER_EMAIL != #{memEmail} AND IS_READ = 0
mapper.select: SELECT MEM_PROFILE_IMG AS senderProfileImg , MEM_NICKNAME AS senderNickname FROM MEM_INFO WHERE MEM_EMAIL = #{senderEmail}
